commits.subject: Fix Python escape sequences in IP SHIELD workflow
Document AEGIS IP SHIELD provenance workflow
Add AEGIS IP SHIELD provenance workflow
- Updating build.xml. - Deprecating javax.naming classes. - Javadoc fixes. - Made logging consistent, removed printStackTraces.
- Simplification and shift in focus of top level API.
- Restructuring to facilitate AES wrapper because of PACE.
- Refactoring EAC results. - pom.xml - Changes in SCUBA.
- MRZInfo default to '0' instead of '<' for composite check digit.
- See Ticket 23 on SF. Was overwriting feature points array with null array.
- Optional empty templates in DG3, DG4 without random. - Small changes. - Switching off PACE for now.
- FaceImageInfo constructor was not setting all params. - Struggling with PACE with 256-bit AES authentication tokens.
- Moving abandoned projects out of the way.
- Support AA with ECDSA public key.
- DG15 interpretation with EC public key.
- AA, DS, CS, HT verifications fine grained available in JMRTD. - DSCS and HT verification in async tasks in MRTDManager.
- DG14 encoding testing. - Started to implement some TR3105 LDS tests (just for SecurityInfos in DG14 for now). - DataGroup getLength() was not reporting correct length on constructed objects.
- Small changes, protecting SODFile in passport from service.
- Allow codestreams without jp2 header in JJ2000 decoder (as previously). - More verificationStatus notification experiments.
- Fixed a bug in CardFileInputStream when underlying input stream throws exception.
- Pretty printing LDS version and Unicode version in EF.COM.
- Small changes. - UnicodeCountry as (preferred) alternative for ISOCountry.
- Initial support for SAC/PACE. - Refrain from throwing exception when record lengths in FaceImageInfo seem inconsistent with length in FaceInfo (and similar for Finger, Iris). - Small changes.
- Support bitrate in metadata and writeparams for JJ2000 ImageIO bridge. - Other ImageIO small changes.
- Make support for unknown color space more robust.
- Version as used by NFC Passport Reader v1.0 (in Play)
- Nationality (i.e. Dutch instead of The Netherlands) in Country, ISOCountry, TestCountry, ICAOCountry. - Some minor fixes related to PKIX cert chain construction.
- Throw IOException in get file methods in LDS.
- More status info on hashes comparison in VerificationStatus.

- JJ2000 byte[] int[] issue (bug 18, thanks for reporting!) - BAC patch for pre-calculated BAC keys (bug 19, thanks for reporting!) - Verification status for hashes set to Succeeded when all hashes check out.
- Encoding issues for pre-read files (specifically DG14) in LDS, caused DG14 hash mismatch. - Small changes.
- Refined verification status to also include hash validation details (no longer in DS, but has own HT indicator). - Removed BACStore from hostapi (replaced with List<BACKeySpec>). - Small changes.
- SCUBA license consistently to LGPL in own code (was GPL in some src file comments). - Small changes in other comments.
- Still working on progressive rendering of jpeg2K...
- Checking in some changes, mostly related to progressive loading of binary blobs.
- Added encoding ISO-8859-1 to javac in ant script because of (c) Apple.
- Moved InputStreamBuffer and FragmentBuffer to io package. - Preparing MRTDFileSystem and/or LDS to use these.
- Moved more LDS functionality from Passport.java to LDS.java - Some more EAC testing.
- Changed type of keyId to BigInteger (was int) in Chip Authentication related classes.
- DG11 and DG12 LDS 1.7 compatibility, with regard use of A0 for 5F0F resp 5F1A. - Small changes. - Unit tests update.
- Leading zero bug in androidclient for dates with year < 10.

- Cleanup of central threaded InputStream reader in host API (Passport class). Host API is Thread free now. - Introduced InputStreamBuffer class for creation of reusable InputStreams for LDS. Will hopefully make it easier to re-introduce progressive rendering of images. - Renamed progress related methods in JMRTD and SCUBA inputstream classes.
- Introduced classical trunk, tags, branches structure.
